ITEM 1 | Two pieces of fish fillet sitting side by side on the right of the plate; one piece has a dark brown, crisp-looking skin side with slightly charred edges, roughly 5 cm by 3.5 cm, about 1.2 cm thick; the other piece is pale orange-pink flesh with flaky, fibrous grain, a light crust or herb sprinkle on top, roughly 6 cm by 3.5 cm, about 1.5 cm thick, with a small green herb leaf tucked beside it | 120

ITEM 2 | Cherry tomatoes, about 9 whole pieces, mostly bright red with some orange-yellow ones, smooth glossy skins, firm and round, each about 1.5 to 2 cm across, scattered in a loose cluster on the left of the fish; a few show small stem remnants | 90

ITEM 3 | Small scattered pieces of pale cream-colored seeds or grains, a few tiny bits near the tomatoes and fish, each about 0.3 to 0.5 cm, dry and matte | 2

ITEM 4 | A small piece of bright red chili, about 1 cm long, thin and slightly glossy, lying near the fish edge | 2
